comments: Tommy mis-announces the current Iron Maiden single as 'Two HOURS to Midnight'! (Presume he was looking at the clock at the time)
He also announces the band performing 'Champion' as Nuclear Furniture.
Perhaps the back announcement after the Genesis track may explain his mistakes....
